## LEARNING - Evaluate Photo (RFC-022)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/learning-evaluate-photo

**Parameters:**
- `submission_id` (required): UUID of the submission
- `image_url` (required): URL of the photo to evaluate
- `guild_id` (required): Discord guild ID
- `recipe_name` (optional): Name of the expected recipe
- `recipe_description` (optional): Description of what to evaluate
- `criteria` (optional): Array of criteria ["Texture", "Couleur", ...]

**Returns:**
- `grade`: Overall score (0-100)
- `feedback`: Constructive feedback
- `evaluation.criteria`: Per-criteria scores
- `evaluation.improvements`: Suggestions
- `evaluation.highlights`: Positive points
- `xp_earned`: XP awarded based on grade
